replication.target_description: Secondary online replication of Experiment 3; interaction of fairness cue and race on participant identity importance, exploratory 2 × 2 least-squares ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Participant-level analysis; analytic number for the identity-importance interaction is not explicitly printed in the report.
n.exclusions: Analysis plan excludes participants not identifying as African American or White and those not completing relevant measures. The report does not give a target-specific analytic count; degrees of freedom were not converted to n.

n.quote: Participants who did not identify as African American or White or did not complete relevant measures will be excluded from analyses.

notes: The replication report identifies the racial-identity target as the fairness-by-race interaction, resolving the neutral description. Original locator PDF p. 11 contains the measure; the interaction is on PDF p. 12 (printed p. 626). No exact p is printed for that original interaction. The original fairness main effect and African American simple effect are different tests and were not combined with it. Original cached PDF text renders × as ! and < as #. Replication sample size was not inferred from denominator degrees of freedom or recruitment plans. The reported-success classification is outcome-specific, reflecting the author’s explicit “as found in the original study” statement for identity importance; the report separately says the primary trust finding did not replicate. Report title and referenced original were verified against the supplied citations and OSF project.
